annotations.text: Phase 1, what the outside world sees: the marketing site (our brand, dark), the embed form and the report (the agency's brand, light, on siteauditserver.com). The visitor never sees Tidywright on a paid plan.

Phase 1, the agency app. Same shell as the phase 3 screens, phase 1 navigation only: Overview, Leads, Audits, Embed code, Branding, Billing, Team. Every screen gets Loading, Empty, Error and Default stories before any backend exists (docs/31-build-plan.md).
Northwind Digital is a fictional agency used for the branded views. Blue is their color, not ours; the report and form take whatever color the agency sets, with contrast computed on the server.
